sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "signals"."telescref" AS e, "telescopes"."equipstatus" AS g, AVG((CAST(("signals"."polarangledeg" - "signals"."phaseshiftdeg") AS REAL) / "signals"."phaseshiftdeg")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "signals" JOIN "telescopes" ON "telescopes"."telescregistry" = "signals"."telescref"  GROUP BY "signals"."telescref", "telescopes"."equipstatus"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
quantities: signals.relative difference of polarization angle from phase shift
why: (polarization angle - phase shift) / phase shift: the relative difference of two quantities in degree
average of relative difference of polarization angle from phase shift per telescopes within telescopes.equipstatus
share of the all total of number of signals records (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
